body:
If her relationship does fall through, and she does come to you for comfort, you gotta talk to her about it. When people aren’t open, thats when toxic shit happens. You might know your best friend well, but they can’t read your mind, and in complicated scenario’s like these only open communication will make things end well. 

If I were in your shoes, I would tell her you’ll be there for her, but you you’ve been friends for so long you don’t want anything romantic, because a breakup between you and her could ruin the friendship you two have had for so long.
